```python
from datetime import datetime

# Questions 1–3: exact year and month arithmetic.
X = 2016 - 10
Y = (2022 - 2020) * 12 + (9 - 6)
Z = 2018 + 21

Xp = X + 3
Yp = Y - 22
Zp = Z - 2025
cutoff = datetime(Xp, Yp, Zp, 18, 49, 42)

# Missing seconds are taken as zero; PM times are converted to 24-hour time.
exams = {
    "Jason": datetime(1996, 9, 23, 23, 26, 0),
    "Emma": datetime(1997, 9, 19, 19, 42, 0),
    "Joe": datetime(2050, 8, 21, 19, 51, 0),
    "Bob": datetime(1822, 9, 18, 21, 19, 0),
    "Dan": datetime(2050, 8, 21, 15, 55, 5),
}
expected = sorted(name for name, when in exams.items() if when < cutoff)
submitted = ["1996-09-23", "1997-09-19", "1822-09-18"]

print(f"X={X}, Y={Y}, Z={Z}")
print(f"X'={Xp}, Y'={Yp}, Z'={Zp}")
print("Cutoff:", cutoff.isoformat(sep=" "))
for name in sorted(exams):
    print(f"{name}: {exams[name].isoformat(sep=' ')}; strictly before={exams[name] < cutoff}")
print("Expected:", "[" + ", ".join(expected) + "]")
print("Submitted:", "[" + ", ".join(submitted) + "]")
print("The question requires alphabetically ordered person names, not dates.")
print("CHECK PASS" if submitted == expected else "CHECK FAIL")
```
